mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a warm 79 degrees by the Military Ridge State Trail under clear skies, though the air quality index is currently at 54.

The city recently updated the engineering services page with reports dating back several years. Additionally, the Senior Center is promoting their tri-shaw bike program, which offers free rides for seniors along the Military Ridge State Trail.
Today features live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's.
Regarding the weekly police recap, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a passenger being cited for possession of T H C and drug paraphernalia.
The flavor of the day is Really Reese's, and the restaurant is open until 10:30 PM. For another cool treat, the Kona Ice truck will be at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 4 PM.
